text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way back from an outing with Transcend—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh. Trainy, look, look.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Earlier at the bookstore, you bought the
"B-Horror Movie Special" and got a raffle ticket, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying 'Here,' I hand the raffle tickets to Transcend as if it's the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're leaving it to me, I've got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm going big here... and aiming for the hot springs~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend eagerly turned
the lottery machine's crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, seriously?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan, they said hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Isn't my luck a bit too good~?
I just hope I haven't used it all up.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip, I'm so jealous!
That's a pair travel voucher, right?
And for a pretty fancy inn, too!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm sure all of her friends will want to go. It must be tough deciding who to take along.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So, when are we going?
choice_data_list: That'll be difficult for a while, I think

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I know, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, if we're going, there are a bunch of things I'd like to look into first anyway.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"We'll pick the right time, then.
For now, I'll leave the travel voucher with you~."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's an undiscovered spot nearby,
a hidden hot spring. A secret bath.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Maybe I should make a travel itinerary?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Imagining the day of the hot spring trip,
Transcend walked with a buoyant, excited skip in her step."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, we missed out on the hot springs~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Can we split it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I can handle this size.
Trainy, get the white rice ready~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy some side dishes too!
That way we can slap 'Our Special' in front of 'Deluxe'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After returning to the academy, I collaborated with Transcend to create the ultimate carrot hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Isn't it perfect?
choice_data_list: The Umamusume lured by the smell are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several Umamusume are looking over with glaring eyes...
A "just one bite" attack might be imminent!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Oh no, I have to eat this fast...!
Wait, before that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
'#TrainerAndToraChanSpecial'
'#UltimateCollab'
'#OurCarrotSalisburySteak', and done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Transcend types out her Umastagram post,
vocalizing the tags—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gathered Umamusume left apologetically.
Transcend and I tilted our heads in bewilderment.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I don't really get it, but looks like we can eat peacefully now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The special hamburger steak I grilled
together with Transcend tasted
far beyond top-tier.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, guess that's about it~
Trai-chan, want half?"
choice_data_list: No, just two or three would be...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll take my share...
and hand out the rest to my friends.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe if I give these to Accu-san,
she'll make some pickles.
Guess I'll go ask her!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hitting the carrot prize is amazing!
I'll make some delicious pickles with them, so look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Accu-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but shouldn't Tran-san
be the one to pickle Trainer's portion?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, it'd be such a waste if I messed up, so I'll ask Accu-san~.
I'll help out, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you're talking like it's a given that I'm gonna share some with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ? Was I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Wonder Acute looked on in bewilderment,
Transcend casually scratched her cheek
and chuckled, "No, you're not wrong."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A solitary carrot... It brings about a strange sense of melancholy...
choice_data_list: Anything tastes like a feast when we eat together!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, Trainer-chan!
...And don't say that while fake-crying!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After letting out a chuckle,
she stared intently at the single carrot in my hand.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: How about we cut 'em into carrot sticks and snack on 'em while watching a movie?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Looks like that "B-Horror Movie Marathon" is gonna come in handy right away, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's glasses flash.
"Anything's a feast if we eat it together."
—Those words seemed less and less like a joke.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Actually, these tissues have
an incredible function...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You can eat it.
choice_data_list: Well... it does look sweet, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still, this isn't a feature, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Transcend was left clutching her tissue in glum dejection.
